parsed_json.up: Select all compounds associated with the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4028801. Retrieve molecule ChEMBL ID as molecule_chembl_id, preferred name as molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical SMILES. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to allow missing SMILES. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID.
